فَضُوحٌ One who exposes [much, or habitually, or often,] the vices, faults, or evil qualities or actions, of others; who [so] disgraces them, or puts them to shame; as also ↓ فَضَّاحٌ . (TA.) One says, الخَمْرُ فَضُوحٌ لِشَارِبِهَا [Wine is a thing that exposes much the vices, faults, or evil qualities or actions, of the drinker thereof]. (A.) ―
-b2- يَا فَضُوحُ means O thou who act rendered notorious by thy evil character or conduct. (K, * TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
